description:
Universal Paper Roll Towels are an essential supply, and often the most economical way, for away-from-home facilities to meet their hand-drying and light cleaning needs. Universal roll towels come in white and brown colors, with recycled content options available, and varying lengths to meet the capacity needs of various businesses and work areas. They are essentially a single, long piece of towel wound tightly to get the maximum length on a single roll and are often referred to as “hardwound roll towels.” Because the towel sheet is not perforated, or ‘perfed’, universal roll towels are dispensed from a dispenser that has a cutting blade built inside so the worker can tear off the amount of towel they need for the job at hand. These towels fit a range of ‘universal roll towel’ dispensers that are mounted on the wall and are often provided by towel manufacturers. The systems range from roll lengths of 350’, 800’ and 1,000’ for areas that experience high volume and surges of activity like a shift-change in a manufacturing facility or changing of classes at a large school. GP PRO is a division of Georgia-Pacific Consumer Products. FAQ

What different varieties are Brawny towels available in?

Brawny comes in Full and Pick-A-Size sheets.

How are Brawny towels stronger?

While our process and ingredients are confidential, we have applied paper-making science and engineering to increase the wet strength of our towels.

Is the wrapper recyclable?

The wrapper used to hold Brawny paper towels is Number 4 Plastic LDPE which is recyclable. Check to see if recycling facilities exist in your area for collecting LDPE.

Can Brawny paper towels be used for cleaning glass?

Yes, as well as many other surfaces.

Can Brawny paper towels be used in the microwave?

Yes, we recommend white towels for any food use. Improper microwave use can cause any paper product to burn, so please follow the precautions in the owner's manual of your microwave.

Is the Brawny Man a real person?

The Brawny Man was created in 1974 as a symbol of Brawny paper towels. Although the Brawny Man has worn many styles and faces over the years, he is not based on a real person.

Difficile תוך 3 דקות ופתוגנים רפואיים נפוצים אחרים רק דקה. מגבונים אלה הורגים 99.9999% מנבגי C. difficile בהתאם לסטנדרט הבדיקה המומלץ EPA הנוכחי (יוני 2014). זה לשימוש קליני לחיטוי ציוד ומשטחים בעלי מגע גבוה. מגבונים אלה כוללים חומר נגד קורוזיה והם מיוצרים עבור תאימות משטח רחב עם משטחי בריאות כולל פלדת אל-חלד, זכוכית, פלסטיק, פורצלן, קרמיקה מזוגגגת, משטחי למינציה וויניל. כולל ניחוח קל לנוחות המטופל והצוות. מיועד לשימוש בהגדרות בריאות.

Dispatch Krankenhausreiniger Desinfektionstücher mit Bleichmittel sind Krankenhaus-Desinfektionstücher mit mittlerem Niveau, die CDC CMS und OSHA Richtlinien zur Reinigung und Desinfektion von Oberflächen in Gesundheitseinrichtungen erfüllen. Sie sind gebrauchsfertig, 1 Step Cleaner-Desinfektionstücher mit einer 1:10 Bleichverdünnung enthalten. Diese vorbefeuchteten Handtücher sind EPA-registriert, um C. schwierige Sporen in 3 Minuten zu töten und andere übliche Krankheitserreger nur 1 Minute. Diese Tücher töten 99,9999% der C. Schwierigkeitssporen, gemäß der aktuellen EPA empfohlenen Prüfnorm (Juni 2014). Dies ist für den klinischen Einsatz zur Desinfektion von Geräten und High-Touch-Oberflächen. Diese Tücher verfügen über ein Korrosionsschutzmittel und sind formuliert für eine breite Oberflächenkompatibilität mit Oberflächen im Gesundheitswesen, einschließlich Edelstahl, Glas, Kunststoff, Porzellan, glasierter Keramik, laminierter Oberflächen und Vinyl. Verfügt über einen leichten Duft für Patienten und Mitarbeiter. Für den Einsatz im Gesundheitswesen vorgesehen.

إرسال مناشف مطهرة ومعقمة للمستشفيات مع المبيضات هي مناديل مطهرة متوسطة المستوى للمستشفيات تلبي إرشادات CDC وOSHA لتنظيف وتطهير الأسطح في مرافق الرعاية الصحية. جاهزة للاستخدام، مناديل مطهرة للتنظيف بخطوة واحدة تحتوي على تخفيف مبيض 1:10. هذه المناشف مسبقة الإعداد مسجلة لدى وكالة حماية البيئة لقتل الجراثيم الصعبة في 3 دقائق وغيرها من مسببات الأمراض الصحية الشائعة في دقيقة واحدة فقط. تقتل هذه المناديل 99.9999% من جراثيم سي ايلي، وفقًا لمعيار الاختبار الحالي الموصى به من وكالة حماية البيئة (يونيو 2014). هذا للاستخدام السريري لتعقيم المعدات والأسطح عالية اللمس. تتميز هذه المناديل المبللة بعامل مضاد للتآكل وتم تركيبها للتوافق مع الأسطح الصحية بما في ذلك الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ والزجاج والبلاستيك والبورسلين والسيراميك المصقول والأسطح المعزولة والفينيل. يتميز بعطر خفيف لراحة المريض والعاملين. مخصص للاستخدام في أماكن الرعاية الصحية.

As toalhas desinfetantes de limpeza hospitalar com alvejante são lenços desinfetantes hospitalares de nível intermediário que atendem às diretrizes CDC CMS e OSHA para limpeza e desinfetação de superfícies em instalações de saúde. Eles estão prontos para usar, 1 etapa de limpeza e desinfetante de lenços contendo uma diluição de alvejante de 1:10. Estas toalhas pré-umedecidas são registradas pela EPA para matar C. Esporos difíficos em 3 minutos e outros patógenos comuns de saúde em apenas 1 minuto. Estes lenços matam 99,999% dos esporos difficile de acordo com o padrão de teste recomendado pela EPA (junho de 2014). Isso é para uso clínico para desinfetar equipamentos e superfícies de alto toque. Estes lenços apresentam um agente anticorrosão e são formulados para ampla compatibilidade de superfícies com superfícies de saúde, incluindo aço inoxidável, vidro, plástico, porcelana, cerâmica esmaltada, superfícies laminadas e vinil. Apresenta uma fragrância leve para o conforto do paciente e da equipe. Destinado a uso em ambientes de saúde.

送出醫院清潔消毒劑毛巾含漂白劑是中級醫院消毒劑濕巾,符合 CDC CMS 和 OSHA 醫療保健設施表面清潔和消毒的指南。 可使用,含 1:10 漂白劑稀釋的 1 步驟清潔消毒濕巾。 這些預濕毛巾經 EPA 認證,可在 3 分鐘內殺死 C. Difficile 孢子,其他常見的醫療保健病原體只需 1 分鐘。 根據目前美國環保局推薦的測試標準(2014 年 6 月),這些濕巾可殺死 99.999% 的難孢子。 適用於消毒設備和高接觸表面。 ​ 這些濕巾採用抗腐蝕劑,配方與醫療保健表面廣泛相容,包括不銹鋼、玻璃、塑膠、瓷器、釉陶瓷、層壓表面和乙烯基。 具有淡淡的香味,給病人和員工帶來舒適感。 適用於醫療保健設置。

带漂白剂的医院清洁剂消毒毛巾是符合CDC CMS和OSHA在卫生设施内清洁和消毒表面的指南的中级医院消毒湿巾。 可立即使用,1步式清洁消毒湿巾,含有1:10的漂白剂稀释物。 这些预湿毛巾已通过 EPA 注册,可在 3 分钟内杀死难孢子,而其他常见的医疗病原体只需 1 分钟。 根据当前 EPA 建议的测试标准,这些湿巾可杀死 99.9999% 的 C 难度孢子。 用于消毒设备和高接触表面的临床用途。 这些湿巾具有防腐剂,配方广泛兼容医疗表面,包括不锈钢、玻璃、塑料、瓷器、釉陶瓷、层压表面和乙烯基。 散发淡淡的香味,让病人和员工倍感舒适。 用于医疗保健设置。

Disatch 병원 클리너 소독제 타월은 의료 시설의 표면 청소 및 소독을 위한 CDC CMS 및 OSHA 지침을 충족하는 중급 병원 소독제 물티슈입니다. 바로 사용할 수 있습니다. 1:10 표백제 희석이 포함된 1단계 클리너 소독 물티슈입니다. 이 사전 촉촉한 타월은 EPA에 등록되어 C. description:
Wanna guess the top reason Americans are delayed when leaving home? They are searching for car or house keys! Under the pillows? In your briefcase or purse?

The Keychain Clip is the best way to keep your keys in one place, organized.

Have a collection of keys? Or do you often confuse your keys with your spouse’s? You can color code keys with matching metal tongues are receptacles. No more mixups!

The Key Holders makes fantastic gifts for friends and family. They're also great for police stations, car rental shops and businesses to keep keys organized.

Remember, you only carry the metal tongue with your keys, the receptacle stays on your wall.

description:

Tired of searching for your keys before leaving? Ever been delayed frantically trying to find them? Bothered by the clutter near your entrance door?

The Keychain Clip is the best way to keep your keys in one place, organized.

Have a collection of keys? Or do you often confuse your keys with your spouse’s? You can color code keys with matching metal tongues are receptacles. No more mixups!

The Key Holders makes fantastic gifts for friends and family. They're also great for police stations, car rental shops and businesses to keep keys organized.

Remember, you only carry the metal tongue with your keys, the receptacle stays on your wall.

Great Lakes Tissue Company manufactures tissue paper, paper towels, bathroom tissue, and paper napkins. The company, founded in 1993, is headquartered in Cheboygan, MI.

Loading Instructions for Center-Pull Towel Dispensers

  • Remove the cardboard core in the center of the paper towel roll.
  • Pull the paper tail from the center of the roll.
  • Place the roll into an opened compatible dispenser.
  • Slide the paper tail through the dispensing hole.
  • Close the dispenser cover.
  • Pull the first towel through the dispensing hole.

description:
Universal Paper Roll Towels are an essential supply, and often the most economical way, for away-from-home facilities to meet their hand-drying and light cleaning needs. Universal roll towels come in white and brown colors, with recycled content options available, and varying lengths to meet the capacity needs of various businesses and work areas. They are essentially a single, long piece of towel wound tightly to get the maximum length on a single roll and are often referred to as “hardwound roll towels.” Because the towel sheet is not perforated, or ‘perfed’, universal roll towels are dispensed from a dispenser that has a cutting blade built inside so the worker can tear off the amount of towel they need for the job at hand. These towels fit a range of ‘universal roll towel’ dispensers that are mounted on the wall and are often provided by towel manufacturers. The systems range from roll lengths of 350’, 800’ and 1,000’ for areas that experience high volume and surges of activity like a shift-change in a manufacturing facility or changing of classes at a large school. What different varieties are Brawny towels available in?

Universal Paper Roll Towels are an essential supply, and often the most economical way, for away-from-home facilities to meet their hand-drying and light cleaning needs. What different varieties are Brawny towels available in?

Brawny comes in Full and Pick-A-Size sheets.

While our process and ingredients are confidential, we have applied paper-making science and engineering to increase the wet strength of our towels.

Can Brawny paper towels be used for cleaning glass?

Can Brawny paper towels be used in the microwave?

Is the Brawny Man a real person?

description:
Soak It Up Sensibly

The complete line of Scott Paper Towels cleans up messes without cleaning out your wallet. Scott Towels feature unique ridges that quickly and effectively absorb messes and leave surfaces clean and dry. That's why you and your family can count on Scott Towels to provide a sensible balance of value and performance.

Scott Naturals

Scott Naturals Towels contain a sensible blend of 60% recycled fibers that keep our paper towels absorbent. Scott Naturals products help you take a green step without sacrificing quality.

Choose-A-Size

With Scott, you can choose the size towel that you need, without wasting an inch - because messes don't come in “one size fits all.”

Sensible Innovations

It all started when Scott Brand put bath tissue on a roll.

It's hard to imagine a time when household necessities like bath tissue rolls and paper towels didn't exist. But that was life back in 1879 when brothers Clarence and E. Irvin Scott founded the Scott Paper Company in Philadelphia. Blending their practical savvy with a philosophy of quality products at a fair price, the Scott brothers invented new categories for paper products that simply made sense to the American public.

As the first company to market tissue rolls as toilet paper in the 1890s, Scott met people's desire for better hygiene while overcoming their Victorian-era embarrassment about the topic - no easy feat. In 1907 the company introduced paper towels to help prevent the spread of colds from cloth towels in restrooms. This too caught on, and by 1931 Scott was selling paper towels as a convenient, sanitary solution for kitchen cleanup as well. Soon after, Scott debuted the first paper napkins and by 1939 had become the biggest selling brand in the U.S.

Throughout the years, Scott continued to grow while staying focused on honest quality and practical value. The 1960s saw Scott Towels as the first available in designer prints. In the 1990s Kimberly-Clark acquired Scott and later introduced revolutionary fast-absorbing ridges in paper towels. With the more recent launches of Scott Naturals Flushable Moist Wipes and Scott Extra Soft Tissue, Scott has become the first value brand ever to achieve billion-dollar sales status. Recently, a full line of Scott Naturals Towels, Bath Tissue, and Napkins has joined Scott Brand's family of products. So for over a century now, generations of smart shoppers have trusted Scott for products that won't sacrifice their families' comfort or their wallets.

Conquer the Tough Stuff

Brawny Paper Towels give you the versatility you need at home: the strength for demanding jobs and the softness to clean up your child’s messy face.

Proudly Made in the USA and Supporter of the Wounded Warrior Project

Brawny Paper Towels is partnering with Wounded Warrior Project (WWP) to support our nation’s heroes and their families.

The Strength to Take on Tough Messes

One sheet of Brawny towels can handle everything from everyday cleaning to even tough messes – durable, thick, and absorbent with the strength you expect.

FAQ

What different varieties are Brawny towels available in?

Brawny comes in Full and Pick-A-Size sheets.

How are Brawny towels stronger?

While our process and ingredients are confidential, we have applied paper-making science and engineering to increase the wet strength of our towels.

Is the wrapper recyclable?

The wrapper used to hold Brawny paper towels is Number 4 Plastic LDPE which is recyclable. Check to see if recycling facilities exist in your area for collecting LDPE.

Can Brawny paper towels be used for cleaning glass?

Yes, as well as many other surfaces.

Can Brawny paper towels be used in the microwave?

Yes, we recommend white towels for any food use. Improper microwave use can cause any paper product to burn, so please follow the precautions in the owner's manual of your microwave.

Is the Brawny Man a real person?

The Brawny Man was created in 1974 as a symbol of Brawny paper towels. Although the Brawny Man has worn many styles and faces over the years, he is not based on a real person.

Sensible Innovations

It all started when Scott Brand put bath tissue on a roll.

It's hard to imagine a time when household necessities like bath tissue rolls and paper towels didn't exist. But that was life back in 1879 when brothers Clarence and E. Irvin Scott founded the Scott Paper Company in Philadelphia. Blending their practical savvy with a philosophy of quality products at a fair price, the Scott brothers invented new categories for paper products that simply made sense to the American public.

As the first company to market tissue rolls as toilet paper in the 1890s, Scott met people's desire for better hygiene while overcoming their Victorian-era embarrassment about the topic - no easy feat. In 1907 the company introduced paper towels to help prevent the spread of colds from cloth towels in restrooms. This too caught on, and by 1931 Scott was selling paper towels as a convenient, sanitary solution for kitchen cleanup as well. Soon after, Scott debuted the first paper napkins and by 1939 had become the biggest selling brand in the U.S.

Throughout the years, Scott continued to grow while staying focused on honest quality and practical value. The 1960s saw Scott Towels as the first available in designer prints. In the 1990s Kimberly-Clark acquired Scott and later introduced revolutionary fast-absorbing ridges in paper towels. With the more recent launches of Scott Naturals Flushable Moist Wipes and Scott Extra Soft Tissue, Scott has become the first value brand ever to achieve billion-dollar sales status. Recently, a full line of Scott Naturals Towels, Bath Tissue, and Napkins has joined Scott Brand's family of products. So for over a century now, generations of smart shoppers have trusted Scott for products that won't sacrifice their families' comfort or their wallets.
